explanation: Notes sit on the lines or in the four spaces between them. Gregorian chant is still often written on a four-line staff, a system that goes back to the Middle Ages.

claims.text: A standard musical staff has five lines.
A standard staff does not have three, four or six lines.
A five-line staff has four spaces between its lines.
Gregorian chant is traditionally written on a four-line staff, a practice that dates from the Middle Ages.
